title: Geolocation entitlement lifecycle and credits triage protocol
creator: Ava Singh
description: Problem statement: Enterprise sales and customer success are increasingly fielding requests that combine two needs: (1) regional availability (new cloud region or edge presence) and (2) formal data residency guarantees. Current intake is ad-hoc, engineering validation slips into late-stage sales cycles, and cost/contract impacts are surfaced inconsistently. This ticket defines a repeatable triage protocol: intake fields, fast-priority scoring, technical validation gates, legal/compliance checks, and a playbook for converting an accepted request into a scoped onboarding runway with clear handoffs.
background: We receive ~12 heavy-touch region/residency requests per quarter. Delays stem from unclear minimum data to evaluate feasibility: traffic profile, latency SLO, data classification, contractual residency boundaries, and expected committed spend. Sales needs a 72-hour signal for feasibility and a 10-business-day scoped offer for approved requests. This protocol ties the intake form to the Console entitlement flow and creates fast-fail criteria to avoid long unscoped work.
acceptance_criteria: A standardized intake form (Confluence + embedded link) used by Sales/CS and surfaced to PM/Eng within 24 hours of submission
A prioritization score (0-100) computed from customer size, SLA requirement, revenue commitment, legal complexity, and operational cost estimate
A technical feasibility checklist that produces one of three outcomes: 'Supported (no infra changes)', 'Supported with Dedicated/Private', 'Requires new region/on-prem assessment'
Clear ownership and SLA for response times: 72h initial feasibility signal, 10 business-day scoped proposal for positive feasibility
Handoff artifacts produced for onboarding: infra runbook, expected cost delta, compliance checklist, contract language snippets
decision_log: 2026-02-27: PM sync: prioritize automation of the screening score to remove manual triage bottlenecks (decision: build scoring in the Console intake pipeline).
2026-03-03: Legal review: residency guarantees require clause templates and KMS/HSM mapping; decision: require legal gating for 'data residency: strict' >= 24 months contract length.
2026-03-09: Eng scoping: initial feasibility requires a traffic profile (RPS by region), token throughput estimate, and preferred SLO; decision: add these as mandatory intake fields.
intake_form_fields: Primary ask: new region | data residency guarantee | failover routing | on-prem/private
SLO targets (p95 latency, availability), peak RPS, tokens/s
Expected monthly committed spend or contract term
Desired go-live window and business justification
triage_outcomes: Fast-Fail: Missing mandatory fields OR score < 25 -> return to AE with guidance template
Can Support (hosted): Score 25-60 and no regulatory blockers -> PM/Eng confirm and schedule standard onboarding
Requires Dedicated/Private or config changes: Score 60-85 -> Eng scoping + cost estimate required
New Region / On-Prem Assessment: Score > 85 or legal block -> trigger cross-functional assessment (Infra/Legal/Sales) and create dedicated project
technical_validation_checklist: Confirm model variant compatibility and memory/latency profile
Validate existing region capacity and queue/bursting behavior
Estimate additional infra cost (GPU hours, egress, storage) and monthly run-rate
Confirm KV cache/replication constraints for cross-region failover
Run synthetic latency estimate using customer RPS and token distribution
Map required network-routing (VPC endpoints, NAT, peering) for Private/VPC scenarios
compliance_and_contract_steps: Legal to provide residency clause templates and KMS/HSM language
Security to vet required certifications (ISO, SOC) and submit gap remediation plan
If strict residency requested, require data-flow diagram and archival plan
Ops to specify audit logging retention and exported artifacts for customer audits
handoff_artifacts: Scoped runbook (owner, infra changes, expected cost delta)
Customer-facing offer (go-live window, SLA language, pricing delta)
Console entitlement config (region flags, entitlements, role mappings)
Implementation checklist for Eng/Infra and Customer Success

risks: Underestimating infra cost for cross-region replication leading to margin erosion
Legal/regulatory discoveries late in the process can require contract rework
High-touch onboarding load on Eng and CS if scoping is noisy
Delays in ENG dependencies (capacity APIs or entitlements UI) will block automation
